description: RC2 hardened command surface (R2-01a): the main window may invoke exactly the ten commands declared in the application ACL manifest (build.rs) -- seven resource-channel commands plus the three M2-AC1 acceptance commands. Any other command name -- including the deleted register_catalog -- has no ACL entry and is refused by the Tauri ACL before the invoke handler is consulted. Probe commands additionally require probe mode registration at runtime; the ac1_* commands additionally require the M2-AC1 explicit test startup configuration (M2AC1_TEST_MODE=1) at runtime.
